title: Durability Helper
description: Never lose your favorite tools to durability again!
body:
# Durability Helper
Never lose your favorite tools to durability again!
Durability Helper is a lightweight client-side mod that displays real-time durability warnings for your tools, weapons, and armor directly on your HUD. No more accidentally breaking that perfectly enchanted pickaxe!

## Features

- **Smart Warning System:** Get visual alerts when your items reach critical durability levels
  - 🔴 Red Alert (Below 15% durability)

- **Clean HUD Display:** Non-intrusive warning text positioned on top of the health bar
  - Compact, scaled text that doesn't clutter your screen
  - Durability counter shows exactly how many uses remain

- **Real-time Updates:** Warnings update every second, keeping you informed without spam

- **Client-Side Only:**
  - Works on any server, even vanilla ones!
  - No server installation required
  - Other players aren't affected by your choice to use this mod


## How It Works

Simply hold any damageable item and **Durability Helper** will automatically monitor its condition. When durability drops into the warning zones, you'll see:

---
### ⚠ Warning: Iron Pickaxe durability (30/250)
---

The warning disappears when you switch to a healthy tool or repair the damaged one.

## Perfect For
- Survival players who want to protect valuable enchanted gear
- Miners who need to track pickaxe durability during long mining sessions
- Anyone tired of tools breaking at the worst possible moment
